slides.small: Keep more of what you earn

slides.title: Separate your money
slides.head: Keep business and personal money apart.
slides.body: It makes your real income easy to see.

slides.title: Know your costs
slides.head: Write down what each job really costs you.
slides.body: Include fuel, materials and your own time.

slides.title: Put some aside
slides.head: Set aside a part of every payment.
slides.body: Slow months are easier when you have a buffer.

slides.title: Invoice quickly
slides.head: Send the invoice as soon as the job is done.
slides.body: The sooner it goes out, the sooner it gets paid.

slides.title: Check every week
slides.head: Look at what came in and went out.
slides.body: Ten minutes a week beats a stressful month end.
